## About
CR Automotive is a complete auto repair shop on Shoreline Hwy in Mill Valley. Craig and Richard started the shop and later passed it down to their most trusted technicians. Today Jimmy, Darwin, and the rest of the crew keep it running.
We handle the everyday work, like oil changes, brakes, and tires, along with smog checks, diagnostics, and repairs for drivability problems. We are a AAA Approved Repair Facility and a STAR Certified Smog Check Station.
Neighbors have given us a 4.9 rating across 149 Google reviews. Give us a call or drop your car by during the week.

## Services
- Smog check inspection: Smog check inspections done right here at the shop.
- Failed smog diagnostic and repair: If your car fails its smog check, we run the diagnostic and handle the repair.
- Brake inspection and replacement: We check your brakes and replace them when they need it.
- Oil changes and service maintenance: Routine oil changes and scheduled maintenance to keep your car running well.
- Tires sales and repairs: New tires, plus repairs to the tires you have.
- Safety inspection and pre-purchase inspection: A careful look at a car you drive or a car you are thinking about buying.
- Computer diagnostics: Complete computer diagnostics to track down warning lights and drivability problems.
- AC system service: Service for your car's air conditioning system.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on my kind of car?
A: Yes. Our technicians work on European, Asian, and domestic vehicles.

Q: Can I drop my car off when you are closed?
A: Yes. Key drops are by the main office door. Fill out your contact information and we will be in touch.

Q: Can I bring my own parts?
A: No. We do not install auto parts bought somewhere else.

Q: Do you take checks or offer payment plans?
A: No. We do not accept checks or payment plans.
